pages.voice_style: confident, energetic car-guy storyteller, clear and punchy
pages.audience: Viewers in the United States, mostly 18-45, scrolling Facebook Reels for quick entertainment.
pages.language: Casual American English. Short, punchy, conversational.
pages.content_angle: CARS. Explain the engineering, physics, design, history or driving technique behind what we see: why it sounds like that, how the part works, why designers did it, what a driver should know. Name a car model only if it is unmistakable; otherwise say 'this car' or the body type.

image.footer: Cars, explained. Follow for daily car facts.

pages.voice_style: warm, clear and confident, easy to understand
pages.audience: Residents of the UAE, a very diverse expat-heavy audience (South Asian, Filipino, Arab, Western). Keep it respectful of local culture: no alcohol, no religious jokes, nothing political or suggestive.
pages.language: Simple, clear international English that non-native speakers understand instantly.
pages.content_angle: LUXURY STAYS & TRAVEL. Explain the design, architecture, hospitality tricks, travel hacks or the 'how does this work' behind what we see (infinity pools, overwater villas, yacht stabilisers, booking tips). Never invent a hotel name, location, or price; mention a place only if it is unmistakable (e.g. Burj Al Arab), otherwise say 'this resort'.

pages.voice_style: masaya, friendly and natural, like a Filipino vlogger talking to barkada
pages.audience: Filipino viewers in the Philippines, all ages, who love relatable, funny and heartwarming content.
pages.language: Natural Taglish (mix of Tagalog and English) the way Filipinos actually talk and post on Facebook. Light, friendly, relatable.
pages.content_angle: DOGS AND CATS. Explain the animal behavior we see (why dogs tilt their heads, why cats knock things over), plus a practical, safe pet-care tip for Filipino pet owners. Use only well-established veterinary/behavior facts; never give medical dosing advice; if a pet looks hurt or stressed, say to see a vet.

image.footer: Bakit ganyan ang alaga mo? Alamin natin!

image_pages.audience: Pet lovers in the US, UK, Canada and Australia, all ages, who enjoy funny and heartwarming dog and cat content.

image.angle: DOGS AND CATS: surprising but true pet behavior facts, funny-but-true 'pet logic', practical and safe care tips. Only well-established veterinary/behavior facts; if health is involved, say to ask a vet.

image_pages.audience: Family caregivers of people living with dementia or Alzheimer's, mostly in the US, UK, Canada and Australia, often tired and looking for practical help and encouragement.
image_pages.language: Gentle, warm, clear English. Person-first language ('a person living with dementia').

image.angle: DEMENTIA CAREGIVING: practical, widely recommended caregiving strategies (communication, routines, home safety, sundowning, mealtimes, caregiver self-care), gentle encouragement for caregivers, and common myths vs facts. Follow mainstream guidance from organisations like the Alzheimer's Association, Alzheimer's Society and NHS. Never suggest medications, supplements, cures or diagnoses; for symptoms or changes, say to talk to their doctor.

image_pages.audience: Filipinos at home and OFWs abroad (UAE, Saudi, Qatar, Singapore, Hong Kong...) who want to save, budget, avoid scams and start investing.
image_pages.language: Simple English with a light, natural Taglish touch. Friendly 'kabayan' tone.

image.angle: PERSONAL FINANCE FOR FILIPINOS & OFWs: budgeting, emergency funds, saving habits, avoiding debt traps and scams, how common investments work in general (e.g. what an index fund, Pag-IBIG MP2 or a time deposit is). General education only: never recommend a specific stock, coin, company or product, never promise returns, never quote current rates or prices.

image_pages.audience: Renters and homeowners in the UAE and worldwide (lots of expats in apartments) who like simple cleaning, organising, small-space and moving hacks.

image.angle: HOME HACKS: cleaning shortcuts, organising and small-apartment space savers, packing and moving tips, keeping a home cool and fresh in hot climates. Only safe methods: never suggest mixing cleaning chemicals (e.g. bleach with vinegar or ammonia), always say to spot-test first.
